title: How Facebook's Algorithmic Tweaks Affected Engagement with News URLs over Time
snippet: Media and conference coverage from Snurblog analyzing Fabio Giglietto's research presentation at the International Communication Association (ICA) 2026 conference in Cape Town. The post discusses Giglietto's findings on how audience partisanship, journalistic quality, and algorithmic adjustments dictate the actual visibility of news links on Facebook.
description: An academic blog post covering Fabio Giglietto's research presentation at the ICA 2026 conference, focusing on how Facebook's algorithmic changes affect engagement with news links.

title: Secondo uno studio dell'università di Urbino l'algoritmo di Facebook ora punisce la politica ufficiale e premia gli estremisti antieuropei. Pd e FdI verso una legge bipartisan sulle piattaforme
snippet: Major news coverage highlighting Prof. Fabio Giglietto's investigation of 2.5 million Facebook posts. The article explores how Meta's algorithms suppressed official political accounts while giving a visible edge to anti-European, pro-Russian, and conspiracy theory networks, fueling debate among Italian lawmakers about bipartisan platform regulation.
description: A major news article covering a study led by Fabio Giglietto at the University of Urbino, which reveals how Facebook's algorithm suppresses mainstream political accounts while boosting anti-European and extremist content.

title: FG's Research Radio
snippet: Prof. Fabio Giglietto's ongoing, self-produced podcast program. The show features AI-generated deep dives into computational social science and online disinformation research based on papers curated by Giglietto, with multiple episodes broadcast throughout 2026.
description: Apple Podcasts listing for 'FG's Research Radio', a podcast program curated by Prof. Fabio Giglietto featuring AI-generated discussions on computational social science and online disinformation.

title: L'algoritmo di Meta e i rischi per la democrazia, l'indagine della Commissione europea è ancora ferma
snippet: This news article details ongoing delays in the European Commission's investigation into Meta's political content filtering. It cites Fabio Giglietto's critical research which mathematically proved how Meta's suppression policy drastically restricted the organic reach of democratically elected officials.
description: An article in Domani analyzing the European Commission's investigation into Meta's political content filtering, citing Fabio Giglietto's research on how Meta's algorithms restrict the reach of political figures.

title: Algoritmi e democrazia: il caso Meta secondo lo studio Uniurb che ha avviato un'interrogazione al Parlamento europeo
snippet: An official press release and news coverage from the University of Urbino describing the widespread media impact of Fabio Giglietto's study. The article highlights how his scientific output on algorithmic moderation was showcased on national television (RAI3's 'Report') and driven up to the European Parliament.
description: An official press release from the University of Urbino detailing how Prof. Fabio Giglietto's research on Meta's algorithms led to an official European Parliament inquiry and a European Commission investigation under the Digital Services Act.
